name: Dalian Demaishi Precision Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Dalian Demaishi Precision Technology Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in the production and sale of highly accurate micro-shafts and meticulously machined components. Operating mainly within China, the company provides a diverse range of specialized shafts for both automotive and motor applications, alongside various other precision-engineered parts. Their extensive product portfolio encompasses numerous shaft types, including those designed for CS-ROM drives, electric motors, car audio systems, worm gears, braking mechanisms, automotive oil pumps, wipers, throttles, eccentric systems, air compressors, EPS steering, vehicle shifting, window motors, and armatures. Additionally, Dalian Demaishi manufactures other exacting components such as pistons, high-pressure pump plugs, intricate assembly and precision parts, plates, cold heading balls, valve bodies, and oil pump shaft housings. Beyond its domestic operations, the company also actively exports its products to international markets. Established in 2001, Dalian Demaishi maintains its corporate headquarters in Dalian, China.
